scope: Original volume lookup import and static camera color-grading controls; no trained model or full scene-renderer bridge
source_layout: horizontal Z slices; x = R index + 16 * B index, y = G index; normalized RGB lattice coordinates i/15
removal: Apply inversion and then remove only this priority/type in the same initialization before settling
numerical_scope: Characterization of lookup encoding/order and presentation. Record all pixel errors against CPU identity, inversion and constant without fitting. These are not reserved acceptance tests.

positive_control.interpretation: Visible response only, not correct color encoding or neural integration

limits: Color encoding and interpolation conventions are not assumed verified
SetCameraPostProcessEffect has no getter verification here; material readback and visible response are distinct checks
Later reserved controls need separately declared limits and scenes, fixed after this characterization
A pointwise color lookup cannot implement the full scene-conditioned model or reconstruct spatial detail
Scene buffers, HUD/scopes, temporal rendering, runtime packaging and complete-frame cost remain unverified
